title: Trust Canal no-change close request
goal: Allow a deterministically proven NO_CHANGE_JUSTIFIED canonical mission to request terminal closeout through Trust Canal without activation, builder work, or mutation.
laws: Only a canonical primary mission with durable NO_CHANGE_JUSTIFIED preflight may request no-change closeout.
The exact preflight artifact SHA-256 is bound into the request.
The mission must still be non-executing and authority-free.
Close request is a separate authenticated tablet intent and Trust Canal receipt.
Admission of the close request does not itself write a result file.
No builder, model, Talos work, Hephaestus work, shell, or product mutation is started.
Malformed identity, stale preflight, or evidence mismatch fails closed.
